description:
Wandering for hours and hours. The sand grasps at your legs, cloyingly close and cool, worming its way into your skin in its abrasive manner. You've been warned - never look through the SEEING STONE in the desert, lest you invite the dead to wander into your SOUL WINDOW. Another term for eyes. It's an old warning, taught to you in your youth. You've never been to the desert before, so it hadn't really come up until now - though the advice seems strangely out of place here. 

Your name is ELEANOR ABBOTT. That much you remember; that and old phrases, warnings. How you arrived here is a mystery, much like how long you've been walking, much like how many grains of sand there are, much like your destination.

Your already low WHIMSY takes a dip into the negatives. Grim determination fills your footsteps.
creatorComment:
Hey there! Welcome to the first page of our webcomic! We're doing something a little funky with it, harkening back to the early age of the internet with forums, and forum games - YOU, yes YOU, THE READER, will be able to vote on what happens each week! This comic will be running for the next month or so, with pages going up on Tuesday and Thursday, and the vote for what happens next being held on each Friday. 

We spent a lot of time thinking about the chaos that was forum games with 'true' comment style inputs and how poorly that meshed with a comic that we want to run for a limited amount of time - and instead we settled on a voting system - where each choice was hand crafted to have impact and meaning, rather than a meandering mess. That's not to say we aren't going to have fun with it - more that our intent is to go on a JOURNEY with people, rather than a casual stroll through a world we've created. Anyways, that's all from me for now, have fun reading! 

- Maia

description:
The TOWER looms as it always does - your destination that you have never reached. That much is known about your destination. The mystery begins at why you're here, why you need to continue forward, what fills your path with unending stamina, and continues into the structure of the TOWER, its contents. The mystery does not end. A single bead of sweat drips down your face, yet your breathing is unlabored. Sand shifts with each footstep.

Your walk continues.

You wish you had a cigarette. Not that it would make walking any easier. Or that you have a lighter.

Your ANNOYANCE increases.
creatorComment:
Maia wanted to have a really long page to make the reader scroll down, giving a sense of the tower's immense height. She had a lot of ideas about interesting ways to use the site format to do crazy stuff with the comic medium, some of which I had to gently push back on bc of technical limitations... we're both really into how a story can be made interactive, and this comic is kind of an experiment for some of our ideas around that. 

- James

description:
You awake in your bed, sweaty, eyes bloodshot.

Dreams of the TOWER again - a sure sign you need to redraw your WARDS that surround the apartment. Another pang as you realize you're never going to get your deposit back - and a brief relief when you remember you actually own this place, even if it was bought off someone else's dollar.
creatorComment:
Ahh, page 3 - the wake up panel... and a color palette switch! Like James said in the last page, there was a LOT of whack shenanigans that i wanted to do with the webcomic format, and getting reined in was the right move - it saved us from likely weeks more work. Anyways, welcome our lovable loser to The Real World - where your room is a mess and your hair even messier. 

- Maia

description:
You summon some power into the object that you hold, a standard can of SPRAY PAINT that one could buy in almost any hardware store. Chanting lightly under your breath one of the many creeds of the underground, of those forgotten taggers who brave crumbling walls, train yards, 100 foot telephone poles, and the sides of overpasses. Your WARDING skill is maxed out, and gains 0 experience point(s).

The familiar, acrid sweet smell of tuolene solvent puts you at ease as you continue a ritual completed thousands of times. Your COMPOSURE increases.

You continue the warding practice, and paint fills the air and cakes your fingertips and gets in your thankfully short hair. Your GRUNGE factor increases.

Your TORPOR skill prevents your COMPOSURE from decreasing.
creatorComment:
Things are happening! A shame that -you- performed some sort of defensive magic instead of painting your name in big bubble letters. Maybe you'll hold on to that paint can and do mischievous things with it later on... although I have a feeling there will be more urgent issues to address.

-James

description:
As you pull on your STAINED OVERCOAT, mouth full of toothbrush, someone buzzes your flat.

Nobody uses your doorbell.
creatorComment:
Get ready... because its time to vote (soon)!! Voting will hopefully close up by Friday night, giving me time to prep the next week's worth of pages. In addition, this will be where things get real funky! Oh, Eleanor, you're in for a wild ride. Things never stay still in your city, do they. You made a lot of enemies, and not so many friends.

- Maia

description:
You glare and roll your eyes as you remember your training, your master's voice ringing in your ears.

'Your power gives you options. Give yourself that luxury.'

Your ANNOYANCE increases. Your status raises from PLACID to IRRITATED.

You consider what you have at hand that isn't cigarette butts, empty bottles, expired train passes, or dirty laundry.

...

Your ANNOYANCE increases again. Your status changes from IRRITATED to FRUSTRATED. Your COMPOSURE starts to slip!

A worn piece of CHALK in your clothing will have to do. You pull it from the pocket of your STAINED OVERCOAT, and draw up some power into it, as you did with the now empty can of spray paint.

As with all things given power, the object reaches back, filling your fingernails with grit and your hair with dust that settles into the still damp flecks of spray paint. Your GRUNGE factor increases. Your TORPOR skill prevents COMPOSURE from decreasing further.
creatorComment:
Thanks to everyone for taking part in the story, your votes decided today's pages :) As I've been learning how to make websites, the backend part hasn't gotten much of my time yet.. it was a bit of a challenge setting up the voting system but it's working well so far! Next one will be this Friday, stay tuned...

-James

description:
'The unknown should fear you. Make the situation yours at all times.'

Your Hopscotch Hex wobbles to full size. 'Sloppy work, as usual.' You shake off the criticism that your master isn't around to give.

The CHALK is consumed as you finish the last simple line, ground to dust in the casting.

The taste of toothpaste is still fresh in your mouth. It competes with a sourness only left by unpleasant remembrance.
creatorComment:
Thats right... a double page drop! I wanted to play this week with some effects like objects are exiting the panels, or panels are overlapping in strange ways. In other news, your master sounds like a real piece of work. Hopefully they at least trained you well... in exchange for aggravation throughout your entire life.

- Maia

description:
The door creaks open. You remember locking it, or at least, you think you remember locking it. The empty liquor bottles around you beg to differ.

The next bit of your training comes to mind, and you prepare the first strike - a defensive hex in place, an offensive spell is next... your brain scrambles for the next object to imbue with...

The door fully opens.

It's a child. Scared. Angry.

She reminds you of yourself, decades ago.

Her knees wobble.
creatorComment:
Happy Halloweekend everyone! Hope you all are enjoying the end of October and perhaps celebrating with a get together and a costume, or at least looking at the trees nearby for a few extra seconds when you can. Here we're met by our second character, and Eleanor's response will be decided in our second vote, closing Friday at midnight. Will this be a friend, enemy, someone from the past? Or maybe just an annoying neighbor? Your guess is as good as mine, and yet you must vote on it!

-James

description:
As she falls, you rush to her.

Your dreams of the tower rise through your psyche unbidden, flashing across your sight.

Something in your SEEING STONE resonates with the cursed girl in front of you, running through the river-worn stone and into your body.

You push past an unnatural flinch response in order to catch her in your arms before she hits the ground.

SELF REFLECTION gains 10 experience!

SELF REFLECTION has reached level 1!

You feel... crushed, in a way. A girl comes to you for help, and your training was useless, as usual. Not to mention the state of your flat - not exactly a cozy respite for someone who might be injured. It might even be more of a hazard inside than it is outside.

'You... smell like spray paint,' the girl manages to mutter before her consciousness goes. Your ANNOYANCE raises slightly.

You have half a mind to drop her on the ground after all. SELF REFLECTION prevents you from doing so. You cling to the shreds of your dignity, and low COMPOSURE.
creatorComment:
My favorite character is making its second appearance... the tower! Right now me and Maia are totally splitting up the work so I handle website stuff and she draws and writes the comic. As a result I only know what happens next in the story when she sends me the files to upload, so I'm on the edge of my seat here along with the rest of you.

-James

description:
You make the unconscious girl comfortable - folding a jacket under her head, and placing her on some thankfully not so dirty blankets.

Your training, in this case, may prove useful yet. This is a curse of some variety. Probably. You're pretty sure at least. Nobody intentionally brings themself into this half-state, and your training gave you at least some knowledge on the protocol for what amounts to a disease such as this one.

Three words. Contain, Identify, Destroy.

Four circles, interconnected. Scent, Vision, Vitae, Reflection.

You scrounge around in your flat for the appropriate objects to contain your visitor, and more specifically, her corruption.

Your WARDING skill is still maxed out, and gains no experience.

As you place the last one your SEEING STONE reverberates, and like a peal of thunder ripping across your brain you see...
creatorComment:
Oh, just a bit more warding... surely this will end up better for ol' Eleanor... but watch out because...

-Maia

BOOM another double page drop!! and we're back in the Dreaming. Also, from now on: votes will happen when we reach critical decisions or crossroads in the paths that these characters go on - they will happen on Fridays generally, but we found that forcing a vote on moot decisions negates the point of the vote. Updates will continue on Tuesdays/Thursdays generally!

- Maia
